theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_finite_rays
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → (∀ x : Euclid P, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (ball x ε) ≠ 0) → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ρ ≤ μ (ball x ρ)) → ∃ F : Finset (Euclid P), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) ∧ μ ((⋃ e ∈ F, (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)ᶜ) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
